title: Distribird：基于文献的先验分布设计工具，用于贝叶斯模型校准
summary: Distribird是一个智能体网络应用，自动化从科学文献中构建贝叶斯模型参数的有信息先验分布。它通过多智能体流程搜索文献、提取并加权数值，使用AIC模型选择拟合分布，并在无文献时提供无信息备选方案。每个先验都追溯至具体论文，内置验证层拒绝超范围请求，且所有语言模型调用均在本地运行，保护数据隐私。评估显示其先验质量与单提示基线相当，但更可靠。
summary_en: Distribird is an agentic web app that automates building informative priors for Bayesian model calibration from scientific literature. It uses a multi-agent pipeline to search, extract, and weight values, fit distributions via AIC, and provides fallbacks. It ensures traceability, rejects out-of-scope requests, and runs LLMs locally for privacy. Evaluation shows comparable prior quality to a single-prompt baseline but with higher reliability.
